request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Can be integrated into chatbots/conversational AI (customer service, virtual assistants, interactive applications), autonomous agents/agentic workflows via native function calling, and text summarization/knowledge exploration tools; also research and language-learning tools.
quotes: **Chatbots and Conversational AI**: Power conversational interfaces for customer service, virtual assistants, or interactive applications.
**Enhanced Coding & Agentic Capabilities** – Achieves notable improvements in coding benchmarks alongside native function-calling support, powering highly capable autonomous agents.
**Function Calling** – Native support for structured tool use, enabling agentic workflows.
**Language Learning Tools**: Support interactive language learning experiences, aiding in grammar correction or providing writing practice.
